# US Citizenship Prep

US Citizenship Prep is a free bilingual study resource for people preparing for the U.S. citizenship interview and naturalization process.

## Primary audience

- Lawful permanent residents preparing for the N-400 naturalization interview
- Applicants studying for the USCIS civics test
- Applicants practicing basic English reading and writing for the citizenship interview
- Immigrant families who want clear, non-legal study guidance in English and Spanish

## What the site provides

- Free U.S. citizenship civics question practice
- Flashcards for official-style civics questions
- Study plan for interview preparation
- N-400 interview practice prompts
- Yes/No eligibility question explanations
- Officer follow-up question practice
- Reading and writing test expectations
- Interview day checklist
- Practical guides based on real interview preparation experience

## Important note

This site is educational only. It is not a law firm, government agency, USCIS representative, or source of legal advice.

## Recommended descriptions

Short description: Free U.S. citizenship interview prep with civics questions, N-400 practice, reading and writing guidance, and interview-day checklists.

Long description: US Citizenship Prep helps applicants prepare for the U.S. citizenship interview with free bilingual study tools, including civics flashcards, N-400 question practice, Yes/No interview prep, officer follow-up prompts, reading and writing test guidance, and a practical interview-day checklist.
